newsitem.title: CHINA: Ford boosts investment in Jiangling Motors.
newsitem.headline: Ford boosts investment in Jiangling Motors.

text.p: Ford Motor Co has increased its investment in China's Jiangling Motors Corp with the purchase of $54.5 million worth of shares, the U.S. company said in a statement on Wednesday.

Ford and Jiangling Motors (JMC) have entered into a subscription agreement under which Ford has agreed to increase its equity share of its Chinese partner to approximately 30 percent for a current 20 percent, it said.
The agreement will be implemented upon approval of Jiangling's shareholders' board, which will convene on April 30, and upon approval from government agencies, it said.
Jiangling Motors will offer a total of 170 million foreign currency B shares, of which Ford will purchase some 120 million -- an additional investment of $54.5 million, it said.
The capital raised will be used to develop further the China Transit programme -- a jointly developed light commercial vehicle that will be launched by Jiangling Motors in December this year.
"This is an excellent opportunity to further the cooperation and growth of JMC and Ford in China," the statement quoted Ford Motor (China) President Vaughn Koskarian, as saying.
"We're pleased with the progress we've been making on our China Transit programme and we're eager to see our vehicles on China's streets within the year."
Ford and Jiangling are developing a light commercial vehicle that will be launched as a nine- and a 12-seater bus on December 9 this year, the statement said.
